# FreeAPIs.io

> > A comprehensive directory of free and public APIs across entertainment, gaming, finance, development tools, and data services with detailed authentication and CORS information.

FreeAPIs.io catalogs hundreds of REST APIs, GraphQL APIs, and WebSocket services, documenting authentication requirements (OAuth, API keys, or no-auth), CORS support, and JSON response formats. The directory covers diverse categories from Spotify and Disney to World Bank data and web scraping tools.

## Key Topics

- REST API
- JSON
- CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)
- OAuth
- API Authentication
- No Authentication APIs
- GraphQL API
- Developer Tools
- Public APIs
- API Documentation
- API Key Authentication
- Free APIs
- JavaScript
- WebSocket
- API Directory

## Media & Entertainment APIs

- [Spotify API](https://freeapis.io/spotify): Spotify music catalog API with OAuth, playlist & library management
- [Disney API](https://freeapis.io/disney): Disney character information API including Mickey Mouse data
- [Freesound API](https://freeapis.io/freesound): Music samples and audio database API with search/upload features
- [RandomDog API](https://freeapis.io/randomdog): Random dog images API with no authentication required

## Gaming & Entertainment APIs

- [GraphQL Pokemon API](https://freeapis.io/graphql-pokemon): GraphQL Pokemon API by Favware supporting generations 1-8
- [Dungeons and Dragons API](https://freeapis.io/dungeons-and-dragons): D&D 5th edition API for spells, classes, monsters reference data
- [PUBG API](https://freeapis.io/pubg): PUBG game data API with player stats, matches, leaderboards
- [Football-Data API](https://freeapis.io/football-data): Football API with match info, players, teams, Premier League data

## Developer Tools & Infrastructure

- [Hasura API](https://freeapis.io/hasura): GraphQL & REST API engine with built-in authorization
- [ZenRows API](https://freeapis.io/zenrows): Web scraping API with anti-bot bypass, JS rendering, rotating proxies
- [CloudConvert API](https://freeapis.io/cloudconvert): File conversion API for audio, video, documents, images, spreadsheets
- [Virushee API](https://freeapis.io/virushee): Virushee file/data malware scanning and security API
- [BaconMockup API](https://freeapis.io/baconmockup): Resizable bacon placeholder images API for web design/testing

## Finance & Data APIs

- [Real Time Finance API](https://freeapis.io/real-time-finance): WebSocket API for realtime stock market data tracking
- [World Bank API](https://freeapis.io/world-bank): World Bank economic & development indicators data API

## Public Data & Information APIs

- [UK Police API](https://freeapis.io/uk-police): UK Police crime & neighborhood data API with JSON/CORS support
- [Hashnode API](https://freeapis.io/hashnode): Hashnode developer blogging platform API with no auth required
- [Amétyste API](https://freeapis.io/am-thyste): Discord image generation API with filters and GIF creation

## Optional

- [Free APIs Directory - Page 8](https://freeapis.io/page/8): API directory listing page 8 with Open Charge Map, Nordigen, Huobi
- [Free APIs Directory - Page 13](https://freeapis.io/page/13): API directory listing page 13 with WebScraping.AI, UPS, SonarQube
